items.subject: Per-axis, per-octave coordinate-state reuse
items.objective: Test whether per-axis, per-octave state reuse reduces total runtime enough to justify its scratch traffic. Compare the scalar baseline with staged variants—for example, storing only lattice/fraction state, then additionally storing smooth weights and shared z state. Preserve the original coordinate-expression order and octave progression. Include allocation and state access in timing; validate n=768 and smaller/shifted bounds at the fixed tolerance. Keep hybrid variants separately identified and measured, and record unsuccessful layouts or attempts.
